tasks.desc: Set up CLI skeleton with Typer
dod: CLI entry point defined in pyproject.toml
Make title/artist optional in CLI add command
Extract metadata from file if arguments missing
Fallback to filename if no metadata
Test with file containing metadata vs no metadata
Separates audio into vocals_all.wav and instrumental.wav
Attempts to split vocals_all into lead.wav and backing.wav

tasks.desc: Implement model weight loader subsystem per ADR-0003
dod: Implement medleyvox.py loader with get_medleyvox_checkpoint_path() and load_medleyvox_model()
Fallback hierarchy: MEDLEYVOX_WEIGHTS_PATH env var -> models/medleyvox/vocals_100.pth -> hf_hub_download()
Update src/harmony_trainer/separation/medleyvox.py to use the new loader
Unit test for loader fallback logic
Extracts pitch contour from mono audio

tasks.desc: Apply SeparationError contract to separation wrappers for development
dod: SVoiceWrapper and MedleyVoxWrapper separate() methods raise SeparationError on failure
Convenience functions separate_vocals and separate_vocals_medleyvox propagate SeparationError
Demucs separation functions aligned with ADR 0004 where needed
CLI and tests updated to fail fast on uncaught SeparationError in development
No separation API returns (Path | None, Path | None)
Verify dependencies install correctly with pip install -e .

tasks.desc: Vendor BS-RoFormer model architecture per ADR-0006
dod: Include MIT license header in vendored file
Hardcode config.yaml hyperparameters as class defaults
Basic smoke test constructs model and runs forward pass on synthetic tensor

tasks.desc: Implement BS-RoFormer weight loader per ADR-0006
dod: Implement load_bs_roformer_model() returning torch.nn.Module in eval mode
Download from anvuew/BS-RoFormer on HuggingFace as fallback
Unit test for loader fallback logic

tasks.desc: Implement BSRoFormerWrapper for lead/backing separation per ADR-0006
dod: Match MedleyVoxWrapper interface: separate(vocals_path, output_dir) -> tuple[Path, Path]
Auto-resample input to model's expected sample rate
Output standardized as lead.wav and backing.wav
Wrap errors in SeparationError per ADR-0004
Integration test with fake model verifies stem file output
Generates targets.json with lead and optional backing
Sets has_backing flag based on backing.wav existence

tasks.desc: Create full processing pipeline CLI command
dod: Runs Demucs, splitters, pitch extraction, target generation

tasks.desc: Vendor MedleyVox model architecture under harmony_trainer.models
dod: MedleyVox network class implemented in src/harmony_trainer/models/medleyvox.py mirroring upstream architecture used for vocals 100.pth
Constructor and forward() signatures support the checkpoint format documented in ADR 0005
Module is inference-only (no training/CLI) and imports cleanly in environments without GPU
Basic smoke test constructs the model and runs a forward pass on a short synthetic tensor

tasks.desc: Wire MedleyVox checkpoint loader and wrapper to use real model inference
dod: load_medleyvox_model() in src/harmony_trainer/model_loaders/medleyvox.py returns a torch.nn.Module in eval mode on CPU
Checkpoint formats from Cyru5/MedleyVox (vocals 100.pth) are normalized into a single state_dict and mismatches surface as clear errors
MedleyVoxWrapper.model caches the module and wraps loader errors in SeparationError per ADR 0004
MedleyVoxWrapper._do_separate() runs a forward pass, maps outputs to lead.wav and backing.wav, and saves them via _save_outputs()
Integration-style test using a fake MedleyVox module verifies separate_vocals_medleyvox() produces valid stem files

tasks.desc: Build evaluation harness for splitter comparison
dod: Runs both splitters on test songs
Endpoints for song list, targets, session state
README with setup and usage instructions

tasks.desc: Add production-oriented handling and reporting for SeparationError
dod: CLI supports strict vs non-strict behavior for SeparationError per ADR 0004
Separation failures logged with song id, backend, and error message
Batch runs continue past per-song SeparationError and emit a summary report
Tests cover strict and non-strict modes and logging expectations
